speech:
Alright, Grizzly Rips, gather 'round. Today's a B-minus, and I think that's about as fair as a church bake sale judge. 3 wins, 3 losses, 12 scored, 16 conceded. That's 1.5 points a match, a hair better than our usual 1.41, and a whole lot better than Thursday's 0 for 4.

Now the ladder. We started the day in Division 4 with 0 of 9 points. That 1-4 loss to Bodtkaa Junior burned our last chance and dropped us into a relegation match. Then y'all went out and beat El Chele 4-2 to save our bacon. So we finish where we started, Division 4, but with 6 of 9 points and 3 more to reach Division 3.

Here's the plain truth, though. We gave up 2.67 goals a match. We opened the day getting run over 0-4 by Hippy Go, and Bodtkaa put 4 past us too. Two four-goal hammerings is not a defense, that's a screen door on a submarine. And our shot selection was like throwing darts in a hailstorm. Shoot central, inside the box. Set your feet. If the angle's tight, cut it back, because a better shot beats a first shot every day of the week.

buddskees, you were our engine, 3 goals and 4 assists, 2 Man of the Match awards, and a 9.3 against fifa ballers. But the Bodtkaa match got away from you: 14 giveaways when you usually have 8, and 4 missed tackles when you usually miss none. You were trying to fix everything yourself. Against Sapa Boys, not one shot on target. Your tackle success sat at 42% against your usual 64%. Trust the folks next to you.

BellyTb1, you were trigger-happy today. 28 shots, only 11 on target. That's a lot of fans in the upper deck catching souvenirs. 6 missed tackles against Sapa Boys, a 6.2 in the opener, and 63% passing against fifa ballers. But your tackling was a revelation, 67% against Bodtkaa, and that 9.4 in the relegation match with 10 shots was you dragging us across the line. That's the player I want.

PhogsToffees, you averaged a 7.5 against your usual 8.4, and it was a quiet day. Against Hippy Go you touched the ball 18 times when you usually get 39. You disappeared. Against Bodtkaa, 0% shot accuracy, and you went 0 for 5 in tackles all day. But when you did shoot, 11 of 15 hit the target, you scored 5, passed at 84%, and that 67% conversion against El Chele was cold as a January doorknob.

Here's what I love. We earned 3 points in the first half of the day and 6 in the second. When things got scary, y'all got better. A team that improves under pressure is a team that's going places. We're 3 points from Division 3, and I believe in every one of you. Let's go get 'em.
